name: Majestic Auto Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1973, Majestic Auto Ltd is in the business of leasing and provision of maintenance services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
MAL used to produce Mopeds and manufactured Automobile & Electrical components. Currently, company is in the business of commercial real estate. It provides office space on lease and facility management services

pros: Stock is trading at 0.50 times its book value
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 136%
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -1.44% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 2.76% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.115 Cr.
Company's cost of borrowing seems high
